lead: Tax, invoices, currencies, contract length, what counts as a user. As an accordion or as an open list in up to three columns.
note: The note is where the date of the answers goes, and what overrides them.

questions.title: The accordion is native disclosure markup
questions.bodytext: A details element per row. The open state, the keyboard behaviour and the print rendering are the browser's own, and the band works with scripting switched off.

questions.title: Opening one row closes the rest
questions.bodytext: Through the shared name attribute rather than through a line of script. The name is keyed to the record so two FAQs on one page do not close each other's answers.

questions.title: The open-list variant has nothing to click
questions.bodytext: The same questions and answers, flowed into up to three columns. For a page where the questions are the point rather than the tidiness.

questions.title: Answers are rich text
questions.bodytext: So an editor can set a paragraph, a list or a link without the template growing a field for every case.
